items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses repeating weaving patterns. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of tessellation. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for quadrilaterals and their properties. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to circle centre, radius and diameter and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching cube nets and views to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on polyhedra including icosahedron and dodecahedron; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
